question: How many subject were asked in the 2011 Census of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**29 subject **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The 2011 Census of India asked 29 subject during the population enumeration stage.
 
• The house-listing schedule, however, had 35 subject. 
 
• The 2011 Census of India was the 15th census in India and the 7th census of an independent India.
 
• The census was conducted in two stages: house listing housing census, and population enumeration.
 
• The census was conducted from April 1, 2010, to February 28, 2011.
 
• The slogan for the 2011 census was "Our Census, Our Future". 
 
• The census collected information on a variety of topics, including: 
 
• Disability status
 
• Number of people in a household
 
• Whether the head of the household is a woman
 
• Number of dwelling rooms in a household
 
• Number of married couples in a household
